details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-53 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_embed_input_file` ignores its byte cap, so helper-missing runs embed non-diff inputs uncapped and bypass the shared prompt-budget enforcement.
  WHY: Every reviewer that flagged it said the fallback path `cat`s full files or otherwise disables truncation/budgeting, so large-PR prompts can still blow past the turn/start envelope when `gh_helpers.sh` is unavailable.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:407-414 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` is empty, the requirement file is written with a newline so `_embed_input_file` emits `(empty)` instead of the linked issue context.
  WHY: Reviewers said this occurs on the linked-issue path, so the judge can make its decision without the original requirement text.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:415-422 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The per-section caps total 350000 bytes, which exceeds the 300000-byte shared non-diff budget.
  WHY: moonshot called out the arithmetic inconsistency, and deepseek noted the same 50k+50k+150k+100k sum against the shared budget.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:426-426 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_BUDGET_BYTES` is hardcoded at 300000 with no override path.
  WHY: deepseek said this is a tunability gap if static prompt sections grow, not an active failure today.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328-328 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The diff-cap comment says it is overridable via the `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES` repo var, but the script only reads the environment variable.
  WHY: Reviewers said operators expecting the GitHub repository-variable UI to work will see no effect.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:472-490 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: PR comments are embedded before review comments, so general discussion can consume the shared budget before reviewer findings.
  WHY: Reviewers said the reviewer findings are the more actionable context and can be truncated or omitted.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:314-330,449-490,595-608 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Temp JSON payloads are written before the shared budget is applied, and the prompt-size diagnostic only runs once after the first sanitize.
  WHY: x-ai said the assembled prompt can still exceed the 1 MiB turn/start envelope on large PRs, so the judge stays review-blocked.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:37-52,421 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The judge script duplicates helper/budget logic and does not keep the new constants and cleanup state fully in sync with the shared helper path.
  WHY: x-ai called out missing README/workflow wiring and the expanded trap not cleaning the budget state file.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:43-47,452,456,461,483,487 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_embed_input_file` defined when `gh_helpers.sh` fails to source ignores its second argument (byte_cap).
  WHY: The fallback cats the entire file unbounded, and the callers pass explicit byte caps.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:407-408 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `FIRST_ISSUE` is set but `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` is empty, `printf '%s\n' ""` writes a single newline byte to `RB_JUDGE_REQUIREMENT_FILE`.
  WHY: The judge prompt then shows an empty ISSUE #N section with no requirement text and no explicit signal that the body is missing.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:426,325-328 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The non-diff shared budget is hardcoded at 300000 with no environment variable override path, and the individual section caps sum to 350000.
  WHY: The prompt fits under the 1 MB cap today but lacks a tuning knob if the static prefix grows.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:407-414 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `FIRST_ISSUE` is set but `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` is empty, the requirement file receives an empty value, causing `_embed_input_file` to emit `(empty)` instead of the requirement context.
  WHY: If a linked issue exists but has no body description, the judge receives no requirement context.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:472-487 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Budget ordering places PR comments (150KB cap) before PR review comments (100KB cap).
  WHY: If a PR has many editor/reviewer discussion comments, the critical reviewer findings section may be heavily truncated or nearly exhausted when the judge reads it.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The comment says the cap is "overridable via the RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES repo var" but the script only reads an environment variable.
  WHY: Operators expecting to configure this via GitHub repository variables will find their settings ignored.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-53 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback implementation of `_embed_input_file` does not perform UTF-8-safe truncation.
  WHY: The fallback uses simple cat, so when the primary code passes a max_bytes limit to `_embed_input_file`, the fallback does not enforce it, leading to inconsistent behavior and possible prompt corruption.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:415-422 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sum of individual section caps (50k + 50k + 150k + 100k = 350k) exceeds the total context budget of 300k bytes (`RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_BUDGET_BYTES`).
  WHY: If PR metadata, comments, and review comments all approach their individual caps simultaneously, the total embedded content could exceed the intended 300k shared budget.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment states the cap is "overridable via the RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES repo var" but the script only reads from the shell environment variable `RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES`.
  WHY: Operators attempting to override via the repository variable UI will see no effect.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:407-414 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `FIRST_ISSUE` is set but `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` is empty or whitespace-only, the code writes an empty line to `RB_JUDGE_REQUIREMENT_FILE`.
  WHY: An issue with an empty body causes the judge to make merge/close/reissue decisions without seeing the actual requirement text.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-53 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_embed_input_file` stub ignores both the per-file `max_bytes` argument and the aggregate prompt budget tracked by `_init_prompt_budget`/`_cleanup_prompt_budget`.
  WHY: When `semble_helpers` is unavailable, all non-diff inputs are fully embedded without any truncation cap.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:483-484,489-490 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The ordering embeds general PR comments (150k cap) before inline review comments (100k cap).
  WHY: Reviewer findings in inline review comments are the most actionable signal for the judge's decision, so they can be truncated or omitted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-48 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_embed_input_file` stub ignores both the per-file `max_bytes` argument and the aggregate prompt budget tracked by `_init_prompt_budget`/`_cleanup_prompt_budget`.
  WHY: When semble_helpers is unavailable, all non-diff inputs are fully embedded without any truncation cap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:40-53,324-326,511-516 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback `_embed_input_file` does not implement the truncation logic that `_embed_input_file` from `gh_helpers.sh` provides, and the local stub always cats the full file.
  WHY: Combined with the fact that `_cleanup_prompt_budget` can be a no-op and the size diagnostic still runs only once after the first sanitize, the shared 300k non-diff budget plus the 400k diff cap can still be exceeded on high-comment-volume PRs.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:328 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Comment claims "overridable via the RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES repo var" but the script only reads the environment variable.
  WHY: GitHub repository variables are not automatically exported to the job environment, so the override only works if the workflow explicitly exports it.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:407-414 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `FIRST_ISSUE_BODY` is empty the requirement section emits "(empty)".
  WHY: The judge makes decisions without the original requirement text.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:472-487 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: PR comments JSON is embedded before review comments, so reviewer findings can be the part that gets truncated by the shared budget.
  WHY: Reviewer findings are the most actionable signal for the judge's decision.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:314-330,449-490,595-608 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Full JSON payloads for PR_META, PR_COMMENTS and PR_REVIEW_COMMENTS are written to temporary files before the 300k shared budget is applied.
  WHY: Semble prefetch and the static judge prompt prefix are not counted in that budget, so the assembled prompt can exceed the 1 MiB turn/start envelope even after the diff cap.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:37-52,421 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script duplicates the `_embed_input_file` and prompt-budget helpers, and the new constants are not surfaced in README.md or wired through the workflow variables.
  WHY: Future changes to the shared helper are missed on the judge path, and the expanded trap does not clean the budget state file.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
